content.short: Covalent provides blockchain data infrastructure through unified APIs, indexing, and long term data availability services.
content.description: Covalent is a data infrastructure network focused on indexing, normalizing, and serving blockchain data across many ecosystems. Its official documentation describes the Covalent Network as a modular system for long term data availability and verifiability, with GoldRush APIs exposing unified access to historical and real time chain data. The product is useful for developers and analytics systems that need structured blockchain data. On Mantle, Covalent fits as indexing and API infrastructure rather than an end-user product, helping teams query activity without building their own data pipeline from scratch.
content.meta: Covalent provides blockchain data infrastructure through unified APIs, indexing, and long term data access for teams on Mantle.
